messages.author: Réka Varga
messages.text: 3320 had the February excursion too — the 2026-05 letter does not cover a second event. 3355 is covered and clean. The raw register export double-lists 3320; the live inventory is the truth.

messages.author: Kenta Nakamura
messages.text: Site A is on the metered basis: 62 samples at the 05-07 count, not the 30 at study opening. The paediatric cohort uses the low-volume control and its own lot.

messages.author: Camille Desrosiers
messages.text: An expedited delivery would be mine to approve; nobody has asked.
